# OnlyMyHealth

> OnlyMyHealth is India's leading digital health platform providing expert-backed medical guidance, lifestyle advice, and wellness resources across diseases, fitness, mental health, pregnancy, and grooming.

OnlyMyHealth offers comprehensive health information in both English and Hindi, combining expert medical advice with interactive tools, educational videos, and immersive health content. The platform serves as a trusted resource for disease information, preventive care, diet and fitness guidance, and maternal wellness across India.

## Key Topics

- Medical Conditions
- Heart Health
- Mental Health
- Women's Health
- Disease Prevention
- Skin Care
- Fitness & Diet
- Pregnancy & Motherhood
- Natural Remedies
- Expert Guidance
- Lifestyle Wellness
- Health Videos
- Mental Health Assessment
- Postpartum Care
- Disease Information

## Core Health Information

- [Health Diseases: Causes, Symptoms, Treatment](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/health-diseases): Comprehensive health disease reference covering causes, symptoms, treatments
- [Heart Disease: Heart Health, Heart Problems Men, Women and Children](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/health-diseases/heart): Heart disease reference covering health, prevention, treatments, conditions
- [Mental Health: What is Early Sign & Symptoms, Causes, Types of Mental Health](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/mental-health): Mental health overview covering ADHD, depression, anxiety, symptoms, causes
- [Pregnancy: Sign, Stages, Symptoms, Precuation & Risks](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/pregnancy): Comprehensive pregnancy guide with symptoms, precautions, diet, exercise info

## Diet, Fitness & Wellness

- [Diet & Fitness Information - Healthy Nutrition | Weight Loss | Weight Gain](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/diet-fitness): Diet, nutrition, weight management, fitness, and healthy recipes guidance
- [Skin Care Tips, How to Take Care of Skin, Natural Home Remedies for Skin Care](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/grooming/skin-care): Comprehensive skin care guide with tips, remedies for acne, eczema, dermatitis
- [Grooming Tips, Grooming Advice, Latest Grooming Tips for Men](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/grooming): Grooming, hair care, skin care, and personal beauty tips for men

## Interactive Tools & Assessment

- [Free Online Mental Health Test & Quiz, Assess Your Well-Being on OnlyMyHealth](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/tools/mental-health-test): Free mental health assessment test and quiz for well-being screening
- [BMI Calculator - How to Calculate your Body Mass Index](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/bmi-calculator.html): Free BMI calculator tool for body mass index and fat percentage assessment
- [Baby Names With Meanings: Baby Girl Names, Baby Boy Names, Indian Baby Names](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/baby-names): Database of baby names with meanings for boys, girls, Indian, Hindu names

## Video Content & Multimedia

- [Health Videos - Fitness Videos, Yoga Videos, Recipes videos, Pregnancy Videos](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/videos): Collection of health, fitness, yoga, recipes, and pregnancy instructional videos
- [Health Short Videos in Hindi: Latest Short Videos On Health & Fitness](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/hindi/short-videos): Hindi health and fitness short video clips on wellness, dental, women's health
- [Immersive Stories, Graphics, GIFs and Videos](https://www.onlymyhealth.com/immersive): Interactive immersive health stories with graphics, GIFs on thyroid, diabetes
